mapper.select: SELECT cc.id AS id, cc.name AS name, cc.is_default AS isDefault, cc.sort_order AS sortOrder, cc.create_time AS createTime, COUNT(cq.id) AS questionCount FROM custom_category cc LEFT JOIN custom_question cq ON cc.id = cq.category_id AND cq.is_deleted = 0 AND cq.user_id = cc.user_id WHERE cc.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY cc.id, cc.name, cc.is_default, cc.sort_order, cc.create_time ORDER BY cc.is_default DESC, cc.sort_order ASC, cc.create_time ASC
SELECT * FROM custom_category WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM custom_category WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custom_category WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custom_category WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_category (user_id, name, sort_order, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{sortOrder}, #{isDefault})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM custom_category WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
